description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering project report searches within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends date range filter parameters and includes fields for project ID and timesheet inclusion options, along with relevant constants and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ProjectReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for filtering project report search results, supporting project ID filtering, timesheet inclusion options, and sorting by project activity name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter object and sets default sort field to 'projectActivity.name'.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Returns the current project ID filter value.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID filter value.

methods.name: getIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Returns the current include approve timesheet filter value.

methods.name: setIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Sets the include approve timesheet filter value.
